scope: Four official API coordinate-commit/readback cases plus one separate human mouse placement/save/readback case; initial native crash retained as failure.
api_cases_method: Use independent test designs in one running Capture session and an existing local library cache. Initial design instances: zero for fresh cases, three for compatibility case.
Invoke the real installed panel search button, result row and place button through its embedded CEF DOM.
Observe the production place response after PlaceNew returns. This alone does not prove that a component was committed.
The test harness cancels interactive placement and calls official PlacePart at a fixed coordinate, assigns the new unique reference, then saves.
A separate Dbo session reopens the saved DSN and OLB to verify count, unique references, value, all pin numbers 1-20 and PCB Footprint.
No test modifies source geometry or the installed product payload. Test-harness annotation does not validate automatic product annotation.
timing_semantics: Offsets are cumulative milliseconds since the scripted search click, including intentional 150 ms inter-step delays. These cached trials are not cold network latency or per-operation benchmarks.

native_crash.evidence_type: CUA dialog observation during the initial instrumented attempt
native_crash.additional_evidence: Cadence errorlog XML and minidump parsed offline; see v0.49.0-capture-crash-audit.json

cases.note: Initial diagnostic attempt failed with a confirmed native crash after PlaceNew did not return. No independent saved placement was verified. A trace-related cause is unproven.

human_mouse_case.human_confirmation: User directly reported that placement was completed in the active task.
human_mouse_case.ui_preparation: The QA script invoked the real installed CEF search/result/place controls; the user performed the actual schematic mouse click.
human_mouse_case.observer_actions: Read instance count and properties, EndPlace after detecting the instance, then save the independent project.
human_mouse_case.scope_limit: One user-assisted cached placement in Capture 17.4 S039; no screenshot or broad manual interaction qualification.

cold_olb_case.scope: Original and experimental numbering values both crashed with the raw path and returned with official normalization. Human commit belongs to a later repair-OLB call, not the initial alpha2 cold call. Existing warm-case totals above are unchanged.

qa_callback_investigation.finding: The hosted nativeCall wrapper appends hostedClientId to Tcl commands; the QA uiPlacementReturned procedure originally accepted zero arguments. The production request procedure already accepts an optional clientId.
qa_callback_investigation.effect_observed: The automatic QA commit callback was not recorded after a successful product place response. An external replay driver completed the official API commit.
qa_callback_investigation.live_verification: Changing only the QA callback to accept args recorded ui_place_returned=1 and hosted_client_argument_count=1 in the compatibility case.
qa_callback_investigation.root_cause_boundary: This confirms the QA callback parameter mismatch. It does not explain the earlier PlaceNew non-return or prove any native crash cause.

normalized_differences: PCB Footprint case in three properties
readonly_olb_comparison.limitation: Not every binary difference is exposed by XML. This does not establish the earlier stalled/crashed session's cause or validate every live design-cache state.

unresolved: The historical instrumented crash remains recorded with a null read in orDb_Dll64.dll at RVA 0x253ea6. Subsequent untraced cold-build controls reproduced crashes and isolated official OLB path normalization as an effective correction on this host; see v0.49.1-capture-placement.json. Cadence internal object-management details remain unproven.

The automation screenshot and mouse-input channels remain unavailable. The human user completed one actual mouse placement, verified by instance observation and independent saved readback; no screenshot visual acceptance is claimed. Keyboard Escape did work during retesting.
The separate Allegro stability result remains 8 successes and 2 failures in 10 trials; this Capture retest does not resolve those failures.
Only one local Capture 17.4 S039 installation is covered; 17.2 and clean customer machines are not covered.
release_decision: Keep the historical v0.49.0 prerelease and failures unchanged. v0.49.1 cold controls and final installed production acceptance passed on the recorded Capture 17.4 host; the new version remains prerelease because PCB stability, other versions and clean-customer qualification remain limited.
privacy: Local usernames, absolute paths and process IDs are omitted. Evidence hashes identify retained local logs; supplier CAD files are not redistributed.
